## Human review checklist

- [ ] I reviewed the current diff, including AI-generated work, against the requested scope and acceptance criteria; no unintended files are included.
- [ ] I reviewed actual validation results, limitations, and necessary documentation.
- [ ] I checked financial integrity and security/privacy impact; no secrets or personal financial data are included.
- [ ] The project owner explicitly approves merging these reviewed changes. An agent still needs explicit authorization to execute the merge.
